title: CemeteryMarkerRecord
description: Standardized schema for historical cemetery markers, headstones, monuments, mausoleum crypts, and memorial inscriptions.

description.description: [REQUIRED] Human- and AI-readable contextual summary of this cemetery marker record (e.g., '1944 Headstone of Annie Lehman (Newville Cemetery, Cumberland Co., PA)').

source_urn.description: Unique Uniform Resource Name adhering to URN:CEMETERY:[YEAR]:[JURISDICTION]:[LOCATOR].

record_category.description: Classification category for physical memorial markers.

record_type.description: Physical classification of the memorial instrument.

cemetery.description: Cemetery facility and geographic location. The formal cemetery name must be recorded in cemetery.details.location_name (e.g., 'Big Spring Presbyterian Church Cemetery').

plot_location.description: Specific lot, section, row, or grave coordinate within the cemetery (e.g., 'Section 3, Lot 14, Grave 2').

findagrave_id.description: Find A Grave memorial number (e.g., '104729778'). Matches token registry pattern FG-\d+.

cemetery_grave_id.description: Internal grave or plot ID assigned by municipal or church cemetery sexton.

carver.description: Name or hallmark of the stonecutter/carver (e.g., 'Stevens', 'J. W. Craver').

person_id.description: Controlled foreign key referencing the master Person Registry (/data/entities/people.json). Must be verified with 3 corroborating data points before assignment.

inscribed_name.description: Inscribed name parsed canonically or captured verbatim in raw_name.

birth_date.description: Birth date inscribed on the stone or interpreted from age/death.

death_date.description: Death date inscribed on the stone.

age_at_death.description: Age as inscribed on the stone (e.g., 'Aged 74 ys, 3 ms, 12 ds').

relationship_inscribed.description: Literal familial phrasing on marker (e.g., 'Wife of William Lehman', 'Our Mother').

interments.description: List of all individuals inscribed or memorialized on this marker.

marker_note.description: Optional notes regarding iconography, symbols (e.g., Masonic compass, weeping willow), footstone alignment, or field observations.

transcript.description: Verbatim transcript of the complete epitaph and all inscribed lettering, search keywords, and legibility assessment.

media_files.description: Array of original photographic scans/images of the headstone, footstone, or monument.

associated_people.description: Array of participants (deceased interred, named spouse/parents in epitaph, stone carver) linked to roles and master person IDs.
